head.script: // The book's source: a TAGGED release of a public GitHub repo, served by jsDelivr. // The ONE place it is stated: scripts/utils/site.ts (siteSource) parses these two // lines for the book builder too. const repo = '{R.source.owner}/{R.source.repo}@{R.source.ref}'; const scope = "{R.source.scope}"; window.R = {R.bootstrap | json}; if ('serviceWorker' in navigator && window.location.hostname !== 'localhost') window.addEventListener('load', () => navigator.serviceWorker.register('/service-worker.js'));
